note: 夕: in the Taiwan standard the short dot touches the long left stroke; in the mainland standard it stands free.
Bottom of 亮: 儿 in the Taiwan standard, 几 in the mainland standard (几 starts with a stroke that turns right at the top).

note: 角: the middle vertical stroke goes through the bottom stroke in the Taiwan standard; in the mainland standard it stops there.
Bottom of 毒: 毋 (one stroke through the middle) in the Taiwan standard, 母 (two dots) in the mainland standard.

chars: 令冷零鈴領齢玲伶怜嶺囹苓羚聆鴒齡澪
